message: In the 100 millimetre Polyurethane insulated cold room (Polyurethane (PU), closed-cell foam insulation) (C1), Manager, the ice-bank contribution to autonomy has unquantified split problem. To check it I used latent heat calculation (the ice-bank latent estimate (E23)). I found 9.28 kilowatt-hours thermal from 100 kilograms ice at 334 kilojoules per kilogram, according to American Society of Heating, Refrigerating and Air-Conditioning Engineers Handbook, 2022. I propose integrate 100 kilogram ice-bank boxes under the evaporator to carry night steady load off battery. My position: not ready because joint electrical closure with you is still pending. In the Direct Current vapour-compression cooler (Direct Current (DC), battery-driven cooling) (C1), Maya, the night compressor cycling has solar-budget mismatch problem. To check it I used steady load review reusing the updated daily load calc (E16). I found about 2.6 kilowatt-hours electric steady load can shift to ice made in daytime surplus, according to Azzouz and co-workers, 2020 on Coefficient of Performance (Coefficient of Performance (COP), cooling per electricity). I propose daytime ice charging with low-speed fan discharge at night plus shaded condenser. My position: not ready because roof array sizing by you must cover charging surplus.
